info.title: Assured Platform API
info.description:
Welcome to the Assured Platform API

This API documentation provides all necessary information for developers to integrate with the Assured platform.

Assured is designed with an API-first approach, meaning APIs are designed and developed first, with user interfaces built on top. This makes the APIs reusable, robust, and easy to integrate for third-party developers.

Please note that the API and platform are under active development and subject to significant changes, including breaking changes. Refer to this documentation regularly for the most up-to-date information.

API Key Authentication

Use your account API key to authenticate. If you don't have an API key, get in touch with us by reaching out to support@withassured.com.

Add the API key to the header of your requests.

headers: {'x-api-key': 'YOUR_SECRET_TOKEN'}

post.summary: Bulk OA assignment to payer enrollment requests
post.description: Bulk-assign OAs to payer enrollment requests belonging to the requesting org admin's client. Target requests can be selected by explicit enrollment_request_ids and/or by filter criteria (health_plan_ids, states). At least one of enrollment_request_ids, health_plan_ids, or states must be provided.

oas_to_assign.description:
IDs of the OAs to assign. If multiple OAs are provided, matching requests are distributed across them in round-robin fashion. 

Retrieve /id/ from the payer-enrollment-request-reassignment-selectable-oa-users-list endpoint

request_phase.description: Phase(s) to target for assignment. SUBMISSION_PHASE applies to submission_oa, FOLLOWUP_PHASE applies to followup_oa.

enrollment_request_ids.description: Explicit enrollment request IDs to assign. Can be combined with health_plan_ids and/or states. get /id/ by retrieving list of enrollment requests

health_plan_ids.description: Filter: only requests belonging to these health plans are targeted. Get /id/ by retrieving list of health plans

states.description: Filter: only requests in these states are targeted.

health_plan_assignment.description: Assign a single OA to all submission-phase requests under given health plans.

single_phase.description: Assign a single OA to an explicit enrollment request in the submission phase.

both_phases.description: Assign a single OA across both submission and follow-up phases, filtered by health plan and state.

multiple_oas_combined_targeting.description: Distribute assignment across multiple OAs in round-robin fashion, combining explicit request IDs with health plan and state filters.

200.description: Successfully assigned OAs to the matching enrollment requests.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of active enrollments.

post.description: Handles the creation of an existing group enrollment record, including practice locations, health plan details, enrollment dates, and associated file references.

tax_entity.description: UUID of the tax entity associated with this group enrollment.

state.description: The U.S. state or territory for this enrollment.

health_plan.description: UUID of the health plan associated with this enrollment.

primary_practice_location.description: UUID of the primary practice location for this enrollment.

other_practice_locations.description: List of UUIDs representing additional practice locations associated with this enrollment.

no_health_plan_id.description: Indicates whether there is no health plan ID available for this enrollment. If true, the health plan ID field may be omitted or left blank.

new_health_plan_id.description: The new health plan identifier assigned to this enrollment. Applicable when 'no_health_plan_id' is false.

effective_date.description: The date on which this enrollment becomes effective (YYYY-MM-DD).

no_re_validation_date.description: Indicates whether there is no re-validation date for this enrollment. If true, 're_validation_date' may be omitted.

re_validation_date.description: The date by which the enrollment must be re-validated (YYYY-MM-DD). Applicable when 'no_re_validation_date' is false.

no_proof_of_enrollment.description: Indicates whether proof of enrollment documents are unavailable. If true, 'proof_of_enrollments' may be omitted.

proof_of_enrollments.description: Reference or identifier for proof of enrollment documents. Applicable when 'no_proof_of_enrollment' is false.

lobs.description: Lines of business associated with this enrollment (e.g., Commercial, Medicaid, Medicare).

notes.description: Free-text notes or additional context regarding this enrollment.

welcome_letters.description: Reference or identifier for welcome letter files associated with this enrollment.

contract_files.description: Reference or identifier for contract files associated with this enrollment.

client.description: UUID of the client on whose behalf this enrollment is being added.
